text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"—All events have concluded!! At this very 
moment, the final tournament's overall 
scores are locked in!!"

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: "And taking first place is—!"

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
"Representing Tracen Academy!!! It's 
<chrname>------!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: <chrname>!! Trainer!!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your victory!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations...! That truly was 
magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating, but even more than that! 
<chrname>-san's radiance was simply dazzling!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Once again— Thank you so very much for 
participating in the U.A.F.!!
choice_data_list:
I'm really glad I participated in the 
"U.A.F."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because of the U.A.F. 
that <chrname> was able to become stronger in 
races, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through training across various sports, 
one can develop the fundamental athletic 
strength of a robust body—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Experiencing sports worlds outside of 
racing broadened my horizons, allowing me 
to take a multifaceted approach to my own 
growth."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And above all— I was reminded once more 
of the 'joy' found within sports...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"All of them shine as indispensable 
experiences in <chrname>'s hoofprints...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As a Trainer, I can't thank you enough!
choice_data_list:
Thank you so much for putting together 
such a wonderful tournament!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Now, the award ceremony will be ready 
shortly. Allow me to guide you—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>-san, Trainer-san. Please, right this way 
to the podium.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: <chrname>!!! Congratulations, truly!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You looked so totally cool---!!! Great job 
out there---!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the venue is waiting too. For 
the moment the No. 1 Athlete Umamusume 
takes the stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in deafening cheers, I walk along 
the runway alongside <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Walking beside me, <chrname> also looked proud—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
âThe sight from atop the podium that day 
is something none of us will ever forget.
